_comment: Copy to settings.json and fill in. Changes take effect on next trigger (files are re-read every run) — no restart needed. Keys marked INSTALL are the ones the INSTALL skill interview fills; everything else ships with tuned defaults you can leave alone.

model_access._comment: INSTALL. How the whole pipeline reaches models (card gen / entity judge / night curator share this). provider: cli | api | ollama. 'cli' builds a codex exec command by default; to use another headless CLI (e.g. claude -p), set cli_cmd as a template — {model} is replaced with each call site's model name, prompt is fed via stdin. Note the night curator needs an agentic CLI that can write its working directory. 'api' uses CLAUDE_MEMORY_API_BASE_URL / CLAUDE_MEMORY_API_KEY from .env.

user._comment: INSTALL. What the agent calls the user. 'name' is injected into prompts via the {username} placeholder and used as the user-side label when rendering conversations. 'aliases' (lowercase) are masked in co-occurrence stats, tree tags, and entity graphs — a name co-occurs with everything, so leaving it in poisons clustering.
user.name: User

agent._comment: INSTALL. Assistant-side label in rendered conversations; aliases join the mask list too.
agent.name: Assistant

vocab._comment: Extra mask words. generic_extra: appended to the built-in stopword list (add words that dominate YOUR conversations but carry no topical signal). affect: emotion/situation words tuned per person — start empty, harvest later from tags that appear everywhere.

card_gen._comment: INSTALL: model. Event-card generation. Triggers when a session has >= min_new_turns new turns AND >= min_interval_minutes since its last card call ('short chats are not memorized, new content waits up to an hour'). Sessions shorter than min_first_session_turns never card unless their source_file matches min_first_session_turns_exempt_source_globs (for example, */phone-*.jsonl).

embedding._comment: INSTALL. backend 'api' needs CLAUDE_MEMORY_API_BASE_URL + CLAUDE_MEMORY_API_KEY in .env (any OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint); backend 'ollama' runs locally against ollama_url. bge-m3 is the tested default (multilingual).

index._comment: Card index: entity graph + recursive Leiden clustering. Tuned defaults; leave alone unless you know why you are changing them. generic_frac: entities on more than this fraction of cards are dropped as background. w_emb/w_cooc: blend weights of the embedding and co-occurrence edge signals. leiden_seed fixed for reproducible hierarchies; a community splits only if Q_obs > mean + split_z*std over null_rewires rewired null models, and never below split_min_size members.

entity_resolve._comment: Online entity dedup (merge new tags into existing entities). judge_model is called with small batches; failures degrade softly (tag stays unmerged). cosine_min: candidate screen threshold; top_k candidates shown to the judge; min_df: only tags on >= this many cards get resolved; batch: tags per model call.

ingest._comment: source_rooms authorizes adapter-owned room origin for the conversation-tree contract. tree_card_projection_sources normally lists every tree source; during a source migration, omit a tree source only while the same journal still feeds Cards through one legacy compatibility projection. source_routes remains the private compatibility mapping for normalized v2. Unknown rooms/routes are rejected instead of falling back to the default room. fork_min_shared_turns applies to legacy inferred session forks only. origin_data_dir (optional): Claude.ai export archive; leave empty if unused.

backup._comment: INSTALL. bin/backup-db.sh: destination directory and rolling copy count. Empty dir = backup script refuses to run.

last24_summary._comment: Agent-written short recent context. It receives cards-last-24.md plus a viewer-filtered recall workbench and must pass the same artifact/recheck pattern as the night curator. Requires model_access.provider=cli because the model runs ./recall and ./submit.

watcher._comment: Daytime daemons. bin/watch.sh watches Claude Code files only to ingest them. bin/watch-cards.sh polls the source-independent SQLite turns watermark; auto_cards controls whether a watermark change invokes card generation (card_gen thresholds still apply). card_poll_seconds is the DB poll interval. incremental_ingest only affects the Claude Code scanner: re-read files whose mtime changed plus files sharing a session with them; state in data/ingest-state.json — set false or delete that file to force a full re-read.

nightly._comment: generate_missing_cards: whether the nightly job cards cold sessions that never hit the daytime thresholds. Off by default: on a freshly backfilled database this would fire model calls for the entire history — turn on only after you have carded what you want.

midlayer._comment: INSTALL: enabled + model. Night curator: per-room workbench + agent call that rewrites a tree-projection digest and maintains constants. enabled=false switches the whole midlayer off. rooms: per-room override map; rooms not listed default to true. A room with no fresh cards is skipped. digest_max_tokens is the shared prompt/submit/write budget; home_min/split_min are leaf-identity containment thresholds.
